name: scalvert-skills
description: Source for the scalvert agent plugin.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-cli.mjs && node scripts/sync-skill-scripts.mjs && pluginpack build
scripts.validate: pluginpack validate --target claude --dir . && pluginpack validate --target codex --dir .
scripts.check:no-overlay: node scripts/check-no-overlay.mjs plugins/claude/scalvert && node scripts/check-no-overlay.mjs plugins/codex/scalvert
scripts.check:fresh: npm run -s build && git diff --exit-code -- plugins .claude-plugin .agents .pluginpack shared
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs && npm run check:skills && npm run check:public && npm run check:no-overlay && npm run check:fresh && npm run validate
